'''Daring Way''' was a dark and dangerous<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|166|Daring Way}}</ref> street located in<ref name="LoE" /> the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]]. Its crossing with [[Vos Gesal Street/Legends|Vos Gesal Street]] in the upper part of the district<ref name="LoE" /> was one of the hot-spots of crime on Coruscant, though the danger was part of the attraction for many visiting the area&mdash;as well its proximity to the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]].<ref name="S&V 57">{{StarshipsVehiclesCite|57|In A Galaxy Far, Far Away}}</ref> [[Taxi droid/Legends|Taxi droids]] refused to take passengers to it even with the promise of a free [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of [[Oil bath/Legends|oil baths]] at [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]].<ref name="LoE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Daring Way was first mentioned in the [[2005]] novel ''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]'', written by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="LoE" />
